# Evolve Satin Edge Wrap Scarf: Gentle Overnight Protection for Your Hair

Give your hair a smoother start every morning with the Evolve Satin Edge Wrap Scarf. This high-quality satin wrap is designed for nighttime wear, helping protect your hair while you sleep.

## Protection That Works While You Rest

The satin material is soft and non-abrasive, so it glides over your hair rather than pulling at it. Less friction means less frizz and fewer breaks, helping you keep your hair healthy over time.

## Stays Put All Night

The fitted edge control band keeps your edges smooth and secure, while the wrap holds straightened, relaxed, and wrapped styles in place. Whether you toss and turn or sleep still, you can expect your style to stay put, so you wake up with less to fix.

## Comfortable Enough for Every Night

Customers appreciate how comfortable the scarf is to sleep in. Adjustable tie lengths make it easy to put on and secure, and the elegant look means it works as a nightly staple you'll want to reach for.

## Ideal for Braids and Natural Hair

Wear it over braids to protect your style, or use it after you take them out to shield your natural hair. It's a versatile choice for anyone looking to keep their hair protected through every transition.

## Treat Your Hair Right

Hand wash only to keep the satin looking its best. Shop the Evolve Satin Edge Wrap Scarf today and start your nights with healthier, smoother hair.
